Amantin and Kasei Community Bank Ltd. began in the mid-1990s in Kasei, with operations commencing around 1996/1997. The Head Office later moved to Amantin. Over the years the bank expanded across Bono East and Ashanti regions, including opening a Kejetia mobilization centre in Kumasi in 2020. By 2023 the bank had grown its customer base and deposits significantly, and in 2024 focused on capital strengthening with a five-year plan while sustaining community support (CSR).
Our Board Chairman is Richard Owusu Afriyie (as noted at the 2023 AGM).
